# Tool schema by surface

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/tool_schema_table.py`. Do not edit by hand: `tests/test_the_tool_schema_by_surface.py` fails when this file is stale. -->

The tool schema is re-sent on every step of every turn. This is what each surface sends, assembled by the functions the surface itself calls (see `chimera/prompts/tool_schemas.py`), under default settings, with no credential, no MCP server and an empty workspace. `tests/prompt_snapshots/schema.<surface>.txt` keeps the exact text, so a change to a tool description or parameter shows up as a diff.

**Tokens here are characters divided by four. That is an estimate, not a tokenizer.** The characters are the compact JSON of the schema as sent.

## What deferral takes out, by `describe_saving`

`chimera.tools.defer.describe_saving` run on each surface's registry with `defer_tools=False`: what deferral would move behind `tool_list` / `tool_describe` / `tool_call`, in schema characters (per-tool JSON, so a few characters under the table above). On the surfaces where deferral is not applied the figure is what it would save, not what is saved.

| Surface | Declared | Core, never deferred | Deferred | Chars before | Chars after (core + 3 proxies) | Saving |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Code turn with a screen (desktop, with question and task cards) | 28 | 14 | 14 | 21,133 | 12,474 | 41.0% |
| Code turn that offers the design tool | 29 | 15 | 14 | 26,294 | 17,635 | 32.9% |
| `chimera run` (chat, assist and solve share its deferral) | 26 | 12 | 14 | 18,455 | 9,796 | 46.9% |
| scheduled job | 26 | 12 | 14 | 18,455 | 9,796 | 46.9% |
| messaging bot (Discord, Telegram) | 27 | 12 | 15 | 19,017 | 9,796 | 48.5% |

## Not measured

- **server chat**: built inside `_chat_session`, a closure of the `serve` command (`chimera/cli/commands/serve.py`), which also mounts MCP connectors, OpenAPI connectors and a live pool; there is no callable assembler to run hermetically.

## Conditions

- Default `Settings`, an empty temporary home and workspace, no `CHIMERA_*` variable and no credential in the environment.
- Optional packages are pinned, not read from the machine: `playwright` present (a core dependency, so the browser is registered), `diffusers` and `faster_whisper` absent.
- Tools gated by a key (search, e-mail, image, speech) are absent, because no key is set.
- The Code turn's posture removes the execution tools that the default reach does not grant, which is why its schema is smaller than the CLI's.
